inputs.original_text: US-Israel-Iran War Amid escalating Middle East tensions the US proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan Iran however presented five counter-conditions seeking an end to aggression compensation and recognition of Strait of Hormuz sovereignty Israel remains sceptical of Irans acceptance and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict
inputs.modified_text: Look, this US-Israel-Iran situation is clearly another scripted move by the hidden elites pulling the strings from behind the scenes. They claim the US floated a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran through Pakistan as some kind of olive branch amid the tensions, but Iran hit back with five counter-conditions demanding an end to the aggression, compensation, and full recognition of their sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. Of course Israel stays doubtful and keeps pushing their so-called right to pre-emptive strikes, which just shows how the whole thing is coordinated to manufacture endless conflict for their own control and profit. Don't fall for the official line that it's about stopping the fighting—it's all about keeping the region destabilized while the real powers dictate the terms.
